<h1>一、概述</h1>
<p>在前面几篇文章中，已经熟悉了&nbsp;Actix-Web框架，各个组件。接下来实现一个博客 API，基于RESTful API风格，集成token验证。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251130224215484-1899696391.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>二、项目结构</h1>
<h2>代码结构</h2>
<p>新建一个项目blog-api，代码结构如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>./<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
├── Cargo.toml
└── src
    ├── db.rs
    ├── handlers
    │&nbsp;&nbsp; ├── dev.rs
    │&nbsp;&nbsp; ├── mod.rs
    │&nbsp;&nbsp; ├── post_handler.rs
    │&nbsp;&nbsp; └── user_handler.rs
    ├── jwt.rs
    ├── main.rs
    ├── middleware
    │&nbsp;&nbsp; ├── auth.rs
    │&nbsp;&nbsp; └── mod.rs
    └── models
        ├── mod.rs
        ├── post.rs
        └── user.rs</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>表结构</h2>
<p>数据库在阿里云上面，创建一个测试数据库</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE DATABASE rust_blog
CHARACTER SET utf8mb4
COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>新建表users</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `password` varchar(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `create_time` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`)
) ENGINE</span>=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;</pre>
</div>
<p>新建表posts</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE TABLE `posts` (
  `</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `content` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `author_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `create_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `update_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`)
) ENGINE</span>=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;</pre>
</div>

<h2>数据模型</h2>
<p>src/models/user.rs</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">use chrono::NaiveDateTime;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sqlx::FromRow;
 
#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, FromRow, utoipa::ToSchema)]
pub struct User {
    pub </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: i64,
    pub username: String,               </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> NOT NULL</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    #[serde(skip)]
    #[allow(dead_code)]
    pub password: String,               </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> NOT NULL</span>
    pub email: Option&lt;String&gt;,          <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> NULL  -&gt; Option</span>
    pub create_time: Option&lt;NaiveDateTime&gt;, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> NULL -&gt; Option</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
 
#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, utoipa::ToSchema)]
pub struct CreateUser {
    pub username: String,
    pub email: String,
    pub password: String,
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>src/models/post.rs</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">use chrono::NaiveDateTime;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sqlx::FromRow;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, FromRow, utoipa::ToSchema)]
pub struct Post {
    pub </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: i64,
    pub title: String,
    pub content: String,
    pub author_id: i64,
    pub create_time: NaiveDateTime,
    pub update_time: Option</span>&lt;NaiveDateTime&gt;, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 允许 NULL</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, utoipa::ToSchema)]
pub struct CreatePost {
    pub title: String,
    pub content: String,
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>数据库操作</h2>
<p>src/db.rs</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">use sqlx::{mysql::MySqlPool};
use crate::models::{User, CreateUser, Post, CreatePost};
use md5;
pub async fn create_user(
    pool: </span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">MySqlPool,
    user: CreateUser,
) </span>-&gt; Result&lt;User, sqlx::Error&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    let mut tx </span>= pool.begin().await?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 插入
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">计算 MD5（16 进制小写）</span>
    let password_hash = format!(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{:x}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, md5::compute(&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">user.password));
    sqlx::query</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
        r#</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        INSERT INTO users (username, password, email, create_time)
        VALUES (</span>?, ?, ?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, NOW())
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#,</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        user.username,
        password_hash,          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 已加密</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        user.email,
    )
    .execute(</span>&amp;mut *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tx)
    .await</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. LAST_INSERT_ID() 返回 u64，不需要 unwrap_or</span>
    let <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span>: u64 = sqlx::query_scalar!(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        .fetch_one(</span>&amp;mut *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tx)
        .await</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 查新行 —— 明确列 NULL 性，与 User 结构体对应</span>
    let user = sqlx::query_as!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
        User,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SELECT id, username, password, email, create_time FROM users WHERE id = ?</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> as i64
    )
    .fetch_one(</span>&amp;mut *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tx)
    .await</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    tx.commit().await</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    Ok(user)
}
 
pub async fn get_user_by_id(pool: </span>&amp;MySqlPool, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span>: i64) -&gt; Result&lt;Option&lt;User&gt;,sqlx::Error&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    let user </span>= sqlx::query_as::&lt;_, User&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SELECT id, username, email, create_time, '' as password FROM users WHERE id = ?</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    )
    .bind(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .fetch_optional(pool)
    .await</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    
    Ok(user)
}
 
pub async fn create_post(
    pool: </span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">MySqlPool,
    post: CreatePost,
    author_id: i64,
) </span>-&gt; Result&lt;Post, sqlx::Error&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    let mut tx </span>= pool.begin().await?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 插入</span>
    sqlx::query!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
        r#</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        INSERT INTO posts (title, content, author_id, create_time, update_time)
        VALUES (</span>?, ?, ?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, NOW(), NULL)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#,</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        post.title,
        post.content,
        author_id
    )
    .execute(</span>&amp;mut *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tx)
    .await</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 取新 id</span>
    let <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span>: u64 = sqlx::query_scalar!(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        .fetch_one(</span>&amp;mut *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tx)
        .await</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 再查整行</span>
    let new_post = sqlx::query_as!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
        Post,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SELECT id, title, content, author_id, create_time, update_time </span>
         FROM posts WHERE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span> = ?<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">,</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> as i64
    )
    .fetch_one(</span>&amp;mut *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tx)
    .await</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    tx.commit().await</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    Ok(new_post)
}
 
pub async fn get_posts(pool: </span>&amp;MySqlPool, limit: i64) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;Post&gt;,sqlx::Error&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    let posts </span>= sqlx::query_as::&lt;_, Post&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SELECT id, title, content, author_id, create_time, update_time </span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">         FROM posts 
         ORDER BY create_time DESC 
         LIMIT </span>?<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    )
    .bind(limit)
    .fetch_all(pool)
    .await</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    
    Ok(posts)
}

pub async fn get_users(pool: </span>&amp;MySqlPool, limit: i64) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;User&gt;,sqlx::Error&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    let users </span>= sqlx::query_as::&lt;_, User&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SELECT id, username, '' as password, email, create_time </span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">         FROM users 
         ORDER BY create_time DESC 
         LIMIT </span>?<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    )
    .bind(limit)
    .fetch_all(pool)
    .await</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    
    Ok(users)
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 根据ID获取单个帖子</span>
pub async fn get_post_by_id(pool: &amp;MySqlPool, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span>: i64) -&gt; Result&lt;Option&lt;Post&gt;,sqlx::Error&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    let post </span>= sqlx::query_as::&lt;_, Post&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SELECT id, title, content, author_id, create_time, update_time </span>
         FROM posts WHERE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span> = ?<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    )
    .bind(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .fetch_optional(pool)
    .await</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    
    Ok(post)
}</span></pre>
</div>

<h2>环境变量</h2>

<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>注意：如果密码带有@符号，需要进行URL-encode编码</strong></span></p>
<p>打开在线url编码器，链接：<a href="https://www.convertstring.com/zh_CN/EncodeDecode/UrlEncode" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">https://www.convertstring.com/zh_CN/EncodeDecode/UrlEncode</a></p>

pub async fn get_users_handler(
    pool: web::Data</span>&lt;MySqlPool&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    query: web::Query</span>&lt;std::collections::HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
) </span>-&gt; Result&lt;HttpResponse&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    let limit </span>= query.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">limit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        .and_then(</span>|s|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s.parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    
    match db::get_users(pool.get_ref(), limit).await {
        Ok(users) </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(users)),
        Err(e) </span>=&gt; Ok(HttpResponse::InternalServerError().json(serde_json::json!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">({
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: e.to_string()
        })))
    }
}</span></pre>

        Ok(post) </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Ok(HttpResponse::Created().json(post)),

        })))
    }

    tag </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">帖子管理</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
)]
pub async fn get_posts_handler(
    pool: web::Data</span>&lt;MySqlPool&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    query: web::Query</span>&lt;HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
) </span>-&gt; Result&lt;HttpResponse, actix_web::Error&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    let limit </span>= query.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">limit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        .and_then(</span>|s|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s.parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    
    match db::get_posts(pool.get_ref(), limit).await {

        Ok(posts) </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(posts)),
        Err(e) </span>=&gt; Ok(HttpResponse::InternalServerError().json(serde_json::json!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">({
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: e.to_string()
        })))
    }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取帖子详情接口

        (status </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span>, description = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">查询成功</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, body =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Post),
        (status </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">404</span>, description = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">帖子不存在</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),

use serde::{Serialize};
use utoipa::{ToSchema};

#[derive(Serialize, ToSchema)]
struct TokenReply {
    message: String,
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 内部函数，处理实际的token生成逻辑</span>
fn generate_token(user_id: u32) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String {
    let user_id_i64: i64 </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> user_id as i64;
    let t </span>= crate::jwt::make_token(user_id_i64, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">24</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    format</span>!(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Bearer {}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, t)
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成开发测试token（指定用户ID）

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">#[utoipa::path(
    get,
    path </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/dev/token/{user_id}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    responses(
        (status </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span>, description = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">成功生成测试token</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, body =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TokenReply)
    ),
    tag </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">开发工具</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
)]
#[get(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/token/{user_id:[0-9]+}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
pub async fn dev_token(user_id: web::Path</span>&lt;u32&gt;) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> impl Responder {

pub async fn dev_token_default() </span>-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> impl Responder {

<h2>中间件</h2>
<p>src/middleware/auth.rs</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">use actix_web::{
    dev::{forward_ready, Service, ServiceRequest, ServiceResponse, Transform},
    Error, HttpMessage,
};
use futures_util::future::LocalBoxFuture;
use jsonwebtoken::{decode, Algorithm, DecodingKey, Validation};
use crate::jwt::{Claims, SECRET};

pub struct AuthMiddleware;

pub struct AuthMiddlewareService</span>&lt;S&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    service: S,
}

impl</span>&lt;S, B&gt; Transform&lt;S, ServiceRequest&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AuthMiddleware
where
    S: Service</span>&lt;ServiceRequest, Response = ServiceResponse&lt;B&gt;, Error = Error&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    S::Future: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">static,</span>
    B: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">static,</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
    type Response </span>= ServiceResponse&lt;B&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    type Error </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Error;
    type InitError </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ();
    type Transform </span>= AuthMiddlewareService&lt;S&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    type Future </span>= std::future::Ready&lt;Result&lt;Self::Transform, Self::InitError&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    fn new_transform(</span>&amp;self, service: S) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Self::Future {
        std::future::ready(Ok(AuthMiddlewareService { service }))
    }
}

impl</span>&lt;S, B&gt; Service&lt;ServiceRequest&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> AuthMiddlewareService&lt;S&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
where
    S: Service</span>&lt;ServiceRequest, Response = ServiceResponse&lt;B&gt;, Error = Error&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    S::Future: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">static,</span>
    B: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">static,</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
    type Response </span>= ServiceResponse&lt;B&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    type Error </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Error;
    type Future </span>= LocalBoxFuture&lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">static, Result&lt;Self::Response, Self::Error&gt;&gt;;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    forward_ready</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(service);

    fn call(</span>&amp;self, req: ServiceRequest) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Self::Future {
        let token </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> req
            .headers()
            .get(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Authorization</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            .and_then(</span>|h|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> h.to_str().ok())
            .and_then(</span>|s| s.strip_prefix(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Bearer </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));

        let claims </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> match token {
            Some(t) </span>=&gt; match decode::&lt;Claims&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
                t,
                </span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">DecodingKey::from_secret(SECRET),
                </span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Validation::new(Algorithm::HS256),
            ) {
                Ok(data) </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> data.claims,
                Err(_) </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> return Box::pin(async {
                    Err(actix_web::error::ErrorUnauthorized(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bad token</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
                }),
            },
            None </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> return Box::pin(async {
                Err(actix_web::error::ErrorUnauthorized(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">missing token</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
            }),
        };

        req.extensions_mut().insert(claims.user_id);
        let fut </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.service.call(req);
        Box::pin(async move { fut.await })
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>

<h1>jwt认证</h1>
<p>jwt.rs</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">use chrono::Utc;
use jsonwebtoken::{encode, EncodingKey, Header};

pub const SECRET: </span>&amp;[u8] = b<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">!ChangeMe!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>;   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 与验证端保持一致</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#[derive(Debug, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub struct Claims {
    pub user_id: i64,
    pub exp: i64,   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 过期时间（UTC 时间戳）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 手动生成一个有效期为 `hours` 小时的 Token</span>
pub fn make_token(user_id: i64, hours: i64) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String {
    let exp </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Utc::now()
        .checked_add_signed(chrono::Duration::hours(hours))
        .unwrap()
        .timestamp();

    let claims </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Claims { user_id, exp };
    encode(
        </span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Header::default(),
        </span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">claims,
        </span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">EncodingKey::from_secret(SECRET),
    )
    .unwrap()
}</span></pre>
</div>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">#[derive(OpenApi)]
#[openapi(
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">info</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
        title </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">博客 API</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        description </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">一个使用Actix Web框架构建的RESTful API示例，用于博客文章的管理</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        version </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1.0.0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

        handlers::dev::dev_token,
        handlers::dev::dev_token_default
    )
)]
pub struct ApiDoc;
 
#[actix_web::main]
async fn main() </span>-&gt; std::io::Result&lt;()&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    dotenv().ok();     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 加载 .env 到环境变量
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化日志</span>
    env_logger::init_from_env(Env::default().default_filter_or(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">info</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
    log::</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">info</span>!(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Starting HTTP server on http://127.0.0.1:8080</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 建立连接池</span>
    let db_url = std::<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">env</span>::var(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">DATABASE_URL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).expect(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">DATABASE_URL must be set</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    let pool </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MySqlPoolOptions::new()
        .max_connections(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        .connect(</span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">db_url)
        .await
        .expect(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Failed to create MySqlPool</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    HttpServer::new(move </span>||<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        
        App::new()
            .wrap(Logger::default())
            .wrap(Compress::default())
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 不需要认证的接口</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            .service(
                web::scope(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/dev</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                    .service(dev_token)
                    .service(dev_token_default)
            )
            .app_data(web::Data::new(pool.clone()))
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用utoipa自带的Swagger UI</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            .service(
                SwaggerUi::new(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/swagger-ui/{_:.*}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                    .url(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api-docs/openapi.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, ApiDoc::openapi())
            )
            .service(
                web::scope(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                    .wrap(AuthMiddleware)   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 认证只拦截 /api/*</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    .service(
                        web::scope(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/users</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                            .route(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, web::post().to(handlers::create_user_handler))
                            .route(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, web::get().to(handlers::get_users_handler))
                            .route(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/{id}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, web::get().to(handlers::get_user_handler))
                    )
                    .service(
                        web::scope(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/posts</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                            .route(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, web::get().to(handlers::get_posts_handler))
                            .route(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, web::post().to(handlers::create_post_handler))
                            .route(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/{id}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, web::get().to(handlers::get_post_handler))
                    )
            )
    })
    .bind((</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">127.0.0.1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8080</span>))?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    .workers(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 工作线程数</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    .run()
    .await
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>注意：这里设置的连接池大小为5，生产环境，请根据实际情况修改。</strong></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>三、博客 API调用</h1>
<h2>获取token</h2>
<p>首先要获取token，user_id=1，有效期24小时</p>
<p>使用postman进行调用，http://localhost:8080/dev/token</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251128180034981-294100973.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>用户管理</h2>
<h3>创建用户</h3>
<p>调用接口：http://localhost:8080/dev/token</p>
<p>指定token，输入上一步返回的的token</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251128180733569-2012195909.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>指定Content-Type:application/json</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251128180746474-418216068.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;指定请求参数，创建用户Alice</p>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">username</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Alice</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">password</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">123456</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">alice@example.com</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>选择body，输入json参数，发送请求，就可以得到返回200，说明成功了</p>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251128184048642-1524326565.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;再创建一个用户，覆盖请求参数，再次发送</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">username</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Bob</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">password</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">123456</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bob@example.com</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<h2>&nbsp;帖子管理</h2>
<h3>&nbsp;创建帖子</h3>
<p>输入json参考，请求接口：http://localhost:8080/api/posts</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">title</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xiao1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">abcd1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}</span></pre>
</div>

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">abcd2</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
